_doc: Hand-entered Shaman effects (Forever). Healer tags: heal/direct/hot, ability:Totems; Elemental tags: ability:Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning/Shock/Flame Shock/Fire Totems; Enhancement tags: white/mainhand/type:melee, ability:Windfury Weapon, ability:Rockbiter Weapon, ability:Lightning Shield. mana_share tag dmgspell = share of mana spent on damage spells per model.

Elemental Warding.note: -3%/rank Fire/Frost/Nature damage taken: ~30% of incoming damage while leveling is spell damage. PvP (2026-09-27): low, defensive: -10% Fire/Frost/Nature damage taken. The survival term already counts it at ~30% spell damage; mages, shamans, druids, poisons and Destruction warlocks push that share higher in PvP.

Elemental Devastation.note: +3%/rank melee crit for 10s after an offensive spell crit: Enhancement shocks every 6s at ~15% spell crit -> ~40% uptime -> +1.2%/rank melee crit. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 0.1% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.3% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.22 to match (0.1%). Other modes unchanged. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, enhancement-dps, training dummy): removing it costs 1.8% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.4% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.4%). Other modes unchanged.

Elemental Focus.note: 10% Clearcasting after any damage spell (next damage spell free): ~10% of damage-spell mana. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 3.8% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.8% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x1.40 to match (3.8%). Eye of the Storm.note: -23%/rank pushback on Lightning Bolt/Chain Lightning/Lava Burst: only matters when being hit (leveling). 2026-09-27 audit: pushback only hits cast Lightning Bolts: Enhancement's bolts are pull shots or instant Maelstrom casts. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 1.2% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.4% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.4%). Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, elemental-dps, training dummy): removing it costs 3.0% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 2.9% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (2.9%). Earthbound.note: Earthbind Totem roots on cast: kiting/AoE control while leveling. PvP (2026-09-27): high, kite: Earthbind Totem roots nearby enemies for 5 s when dropped (15 s cooldown): free casts or distance against melee. Unknown: diminishing returns, whether damage breaks it.

Lava Burst.note: Beta spellbook: ranks at 40/50/60 (150-192 / 179-231 / 192-248 after the 70009 buff), 2.5s cast, 10s cooldown, 165-265 mana, 71.4% coefficient, +20% with Flame Shock. At 60 a Lava Burst is ~1.3x a Lightning Bolt (189-211, 2.5s, 71.4%) in the same cast time and replaces one of every four bolts -> ~+8% on the Lightning Bolt share. Raid sim calibration (2026-09-29, ElliotWood/Forever 40be98e, elemental-dps, training dummy): removing it costs 0.7% DPS in the simulator (scorer said 1.2% on the same scale); already within tolerance, raid effects split off unchanged (1.2%). Other modes unchanged.

Earth's Grasp.note: Stoneclaw health / Earthbind radius: leveling utility. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-26, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.2% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (1.9%). Other modes unchanged. 2026-09-27 audit: split: the Stoneclaw half is control of kind stun (taunted mobs hit the totem; biggest in pulls of several mobs), the Earthbind half kite. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, kite: Earthbind Totem radius +20% (10 -> 12 yd), likely also the reach of the Earthbound root. The Stoneclaw +50% health half only taunts pets in PvP.

Fight lab calibration (2026-09-28, levels 30,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 0.0% on the same scale); already within tolerance, leveling-st/solo-60 effects split off unchanged (0.0%). Nature's Swiftness.note: Instant Healing Wave/Chain Lightning every 3 min: emergency heal, small damage. Healer lab calibration (2026-09-27, resto-heal): removing it costs 0.4% healing capacity in the lab (scorer said 0.9% on the same scale); heal values scaled x0.00 to match (0.5%). Other modes unchanged. PvP (2026-09-27): high, burst: Next Nature spell instant (3 min cooldown): an unkickable Chain Lightning or Lightning Bolt kill shot, or an instant Healing Wave to survive. The PvP builds of both games are built around it.

Riptide.note: New instant heal + 15s HoT every 6s that also buffs Chain Heal on that target by 25%: ~+10% throughput, mana-efficient, castable on the move. Natural Grace.note: -5%/rank spell threat: raid DPS/healer utility. PvP (2026-09-27): zero, defensive: Only -15% spell threat: nothing in PvP (the Forever 30/0/21 draft spends a filler point here).

Healing Focus.note: -23%/rank pushback on heals: ~+0.5%/rank raid throughput. PvP (2026-09-27): medium, resist: 70% chance to ignore pushback on heals: healing while being hit. Core for Restoration, a filler for the 30/0/21 hybrid (its Nature's Swiftness heal is instant anyway).

Guardian Totems.note: Grounding Totem cooldown: utility. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-26, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 2.2% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (1.9%). Other modes unchanged. 2026-09-27 audit: Stoneskin and Windwall only help while you are hit and Grounding is PvP: leveling utility (kind avoid), not raid. PvP (2026-09-27): low, resist: Grounding Totem cooldown 15 -> 13 s (it eats one Polymorph, Fear or nuke); Stoneskin/Windwall +20% is a few points per hit. Grounding itself is baseline.

Improved Ghost Wolf.note: -1s/rank Ghost Wolf cast: travel while leveling. Fight lab calibration (2026-09-26, levels 40,60): removing it costs 0.0% time per kill in the simulator (scorer said 3.8% on the same scale); leveling-st/solo-60 values scaled x0.00 to match (3.6%). Other modes unchanged. 2026-09-27 audit: rank 2 makes Ghost Wolf instant (rank 1 leaves a 2 s cast): ~1.7 s saved of a 40-44 s kill with 6 s of travel at +40% speed -> [0.005, 0.03]; AoE [0.002, 0.01]. The fight lab cannot see travel, so it is no longer fitted. PvP (2026-09-27): high, move: Rank 2 makes Ghost Wolf instant and usable indoors: +40% speed on demand to leave melee, reach line of sight, chase or carry a flag. Does not remove snares.
